verdict.rationale: Threads clearly exist in Slack. First-party copy says AI can 'summarize channels and threads', and community users describe thread replies and their notification behavior, which confirms that replies stay attached to the original message. Users also report usability limits: thread replies only surface in a 'New Threads' view that doesn't auto-update, files and snippets reportedly can't be posted in threads, and threads sit in a small side panel. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing how to reply in threads, evidence of admin-specific thread controls, and confirmation that richer content (files and snippets) works in thread replies.
